---
title: "Getting Started with R and JupyterLab on DNAnexus"
---

This module introduces the standard workflow used for R-based analysis on MCPS DNAnexus.

It is designed for MCPS researchers, workshop participants, and collaborators who are new to DNAnexus and JupyterLab.

If you already have experience working with R and JupyterLab on DNAnexus, you can proceed directly to other MCPS training modules.

## What you will learn

By the end of this module, you will be able to:

- navigate an MCPS DNAnexus project;
- start an R-based JupyterLab environment;
- work with a persistent `[DX]` notebook;
- access project data from R;
- save your work and outputs; and
- safely end and resume your work.
